mod.name: Enchantment Descriptions
mod.summary: Adds in-game descriptions for enchantments to tooltips.
mod.licenseType: GNU Lesser General Public License version 2.1 (LGPLv2.1)

description:
Enchantment Descriptions aims to clarify enchantments by adding descriptions of their effects to enchanted item tooltips. Most modded enchantments are also supported! This mod is available in over 15 languages including Spanish, Chinese, Russian, and French! It also supports all major mod loaders include Forge, NeoForge, Fabric, and Quilt.

Dependencies

This mod requires the Bookshelf library. Those playing on Fabric/Quilt may also want to consider installing the ToolTipFix mod. This mod will fix a vanilla bug that causes tooltips to go off the edge of your screen. Forge and NeoForge both include this fix already.

Configuration & Customization

It is very easy to add new descriptions or modify existing ones. There are also many configuration options to help you personalize the mod. You can learn more about these options on our wiki.
